request.body: Native Playlist4 ListChanges; LOCAL_CHANGES caller=9, non-prioritized. Add has from_index=0 with URI and timestamp only. Remove has from_index/length and URI, no fabricated row IDs. Both request sync/resulting revisions and carry a per-list operation nonce.

acknowledgement: Captured SelectedListContent responses echo the nonce, carry revision/resulting_revisions and sync_result, multiple_heads=false, changes_require_resync=false. Production additionally rereads actual rootlist membership before changing the button, then refreshes the sidebar with collection/artist caches intact.
limits: Two actual rootlist operations prove insertion at zero and removal at zero. Generic positional removal is shared with independently executed playlist operator evidence.
Captures are authenticated live observations from one Free session, not a claim about every account or conflicting-device update.
